definition: UndirectedTendingWitness supplies an actual member and end in the chosen formal domains: it lacks cognition, tends broadly to that end, and has no knowing intelligent director of it to that same end. NotDirectorPrinciple is the exact negation of the existing universal director principle under the same predicates.
